title: break, continue and labels
hints: continue skips to the next iteration. break leaves the innermost loop, and a labeled break (`outer:` on the loop, then `break outer`) leaves the loop you name.
For FirstPair, nest two loops with j starting at i+1, so each pair is visited once in the required order. Stop both loops as soon as you find a match.
PositiveSum: `if x <= 0 { continue }; sum += x`. FirstPair: label the outer loop, set i, j, found when nums[i]+nums[j] == target, then `break outer` (or simply return).
